hook: Spaghetti query ko [[saaf thaali]] mein parosna

slides.title: CTE = query ka [[nickname]]
points: Ab us result ko **table ki tarah** use karo
Sirf **isi query** tak zinda, phir gayab
slides.note: Bole toh: badi query ko **chhote steps** mein todna 🍱

slides.title: Pehla [[CTE]]
slides.code:
WITH dept_avg AS (
  SELECT dept,
    AVG(salary) AS avg_sal
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY dept
)
SELECT * FROM dept_avg
WHERE avg_sal > 50000;

slides.title: Pehle CTE, phir [[filter]]
slides.note: CTE ne 3 rows banayi, bahar ke WHERE ne **HR** hata diya

slides.title: Multiple CTEs: [[comma]]
slides.note: Doosra CTE **pehle wale** ko use kar sakta hai. WITH sirf ek baar!

slides.title: CTE [[kab]] use karein?
slides.note: Interview mein CTE likho to code **clean** lagta hai, points milte hain 😎

slides.wrong:
CTE banaya, ab kal bhi
**SELECT * FROM dept_avg**
slides.right:
Har baar query ke saath
**WITH dept_avg AS (...)** likho
slides.why: CTE **temporary** hai, query khatam to gayab. Permanent chahiye? **VIEW / table** banao
